text: This report advises Toronto and East York Community Council of the status of plans to relocate a Toronto Hydro pole located in the public sidewalk in front of 1009 Coxwell Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested City Planning staff to report to the April 4, 2018 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council with the confirmed funding sources to proceed with the re-location of the hydro poles.
